name: Tree
summary: Tree. Presents hierarchical data with one roving tab stop, expansion, selection, and locale-aware typeahead.

lifecycle.compatibility: Available for controlled production evaluation; the contract may still be refined.
lifecycle.rationale: The hierarchical async-state contract remains beta while large-tree performance and manual assistive-technology evidence are completed.
knownLimitations: Consumers must merge lazy children without creating duplicate ids anywhere in the tree.
Very large trees require consumer performance validation with representative depth and expansion.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: nodes
api.description: Hierarchical nodes whose ids must be stable and unique across the complete tree.

api.name: ariaLabel
api.description: Accessible name used when visible content is not sufficient.

api.name: selected
api.description: Controlled selected state, distinct from keyboard focus.

api.name: expanded
api.description: Controlled expanded state for a disclosure or hierarchical item.

api.name: loadChildren
api.description: Requests children when an unloaded node is expanded or its failed request is retried.

keyboard: Arrow Up and Arrow Down move through visible enabled nodes.
Arrow Right expands or enters a branch; Arrow Left collapses or returns to its parent.
Home and End jump; typing moves to the next matching visible node.
notes: Every node id is non-empty, stable, and unique across the complete tree.
Hierarchy, position, expansion, selection, loading, and error states are exposed.
Disabled nodes stay perceivable but are skipped by roving focus.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Controlled organization tree

guidance.useWhen: Use Tree for hierarchical data that needs roving focus, expansion, selection, and optional asynchronous branches.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use Tree Navigation for route wayfinding and nested lists when items do not require composite-widget keyboard behavior.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Every node id must be non-empty and unique across the complete tree.
Do not derive persistent ids from mutable array indexes.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
